audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Annie/Annie/Skill/Skill/Annie/Skill/Skill while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Diana/Diana/Annie/Annie/Diana/Diana/Diana. Every row disagreed with the sentence beside it.
audit.why: Diana's 900-range Q beats a 625-range Disintegrate at levels 1-2 before Pyromania is stocked; levels 3-5 flip because a stocked stun makes any Lunar Rush a free full combo; Moonfall at 6 and item scaling flip it back, matching 55.8% over 853 games.
audit.corrected: phases[0..1].side = Diana, phases[2..3].side = Annie, phases[4..6].side = Diana, with phases[0..3].why rewritten to match.

audit.why: Level 3-5 is her stun window, 6 is Moonfall, first item is the burst spike, late she is a one-combo threat. spikes[] tracks it. Summon: Tibbers is 130s at rank 1 and 100s at rank 3, which is the number the page never gave.
audit.corrected: Tibbers' real cooldown written into breakdown.cooldowns and loading; breakdown.carry grounded onto a spent Pyromania.

audit.whatIsWrong: winCon said 'dash the silence' — Annie has no silence anywhere in her kit. Separately, the mechanism of Pyromania was never stated: it stuns on her next offensive spell after four casts, and with Disintegrate on 4s and Incinerate on 7s she restocks it faster than your 20s Lunar Rush returns.
audit.why: The stun stack, not Tibbers, is the actual clock of this lane — Tibbers is just what follows it. The page tracked the ultimate and ignored the trigger.
audit.corrected: winCon, phases[2].why, phases[3].why, breakdown.cooldowns, loading and dosFull[1].d rebuilt around counting her four casts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Molten Shield 'damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells' and was never mentioned.
audit.why: Diana's damage is a three-hit auto string plus orbs, which is exactly the pattern that feeds a reflect shield on a 10s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.mid, replacing a fully templated sentence.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries the real numbers.
audit.corrected: Disintegrate 4s, Incinerate 7s, Molten Shield 10s, Tibbers 130s->100s, Pale Cascade 15s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles; thirteen fields called Annie 'he'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists annie as female, and each bullet body explained something other than its title.
audit.corrected: Both bullets rewritten to their own titles; every flagged pronoun fixed in the fields I edited.

CHART: all seven full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and packet.levelChart. I moved the sides onto the existing win[] values, so no paired win[N] edit was possible (before would equal after and be refused) — this closes seven cross-layer disagreements rather than creating any. phases[0..3].why rewritten in the same proposal; phases[4..6].why already described Diana winning. Ratings untouched.
FACTUAL ERROR: winCon said 'dash the silence'. Annie has no silence — this is Diana boilerplate written for a different enemy. Removed.
phases[2].why on disk was garbled ('E pull joins... no —'), a template leak. Replaced.
REPORT CAP: two entries only, both lint-flagged — report[0].t and report[3].t. report[4].t, report[9].t and report[11].t are still misgendered ('His'/'his') and report[1].t still carries the 'dash the silence' line; flagged for a later pass rather than exceeding the limit.
